comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Peafowl Spider

Quest name: A Peafowl-like Insect
Quest location: Calicut Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Ecological Research, r10 Biology, MAL(Malay/Tagalog)
Pre-requisite discovery: Giant Fiddler Beetle discovery (from "Violin-like insect" quest) + Peafowl discovery (from "Plan to rear peacocks" quest)
